Good to know

Questions parents ask

What areas do you serve?

We're based in Naperville, Illinois and set up throughout the western suburbs. Delivery is free within Naperville; a small travel fee may apply farther out — just tell us your town when you request a date.

How much space do I need?

Each teepee needs about a 3ft × 6ft spot. A standard living room or bonus room comfortably fits four to six tents. Tell us your guest count and we'll help you plan the layout.

How far ahead should I book?

Weekends fill up fast, especially spring and summer. We recommend requesting your date two to three weeks ahead — but have a last-minute party? Reach out anyway and we'll do our best!

Is everything clean and safe?

Always! All bedding and linens are freshly laundered between every party, and tents and props are wiped down and sanitized. Everything is kid-friendly and set up with safety in mind.

When do you set up and take down?

We usually set up the afternoon or evening before your party and return the next day to pack everything down and haul it away — so the fun lasts all night with zero cleanup for you.

Can you do a custom theme?

We'd love to! If your child is dreaming of something you don't see listed, tell us about it when you reach out and we'll put together a custom setup.
